propositions: Duration probe implementation must remain modular and stdlib-only, split across rebar_duration_probe.py (CLI/reporting layer) and rebar_duration_probe_support.py (parsing and statistics).

Gated-close phase breakdown must distinguish and report pre-verifier residual, deterministic verifier, LLM verifier, verdict-to-status, and status-to-completion intervals, each labeled as direct metric, direct event interval, or inferred residual.

CLI contract requires repository-neutral defaults for --log-root, --tracker, and optional bounds --since, --until, --provider-prefix, and --current-since, with documented frozen analysis command reproducible.
No-LLM operations, forced/status/check/help/unmatched/interrupted operations must remain distinguishable from completed model-backed cohorts in probe output.
Probe must pass import-walk check and focused synthetic tests without import-time side effects or machine-specific paths, and maintain read-only status without updating duration guidance.
